item.description: Harvey Mason Jr. says the "toughest part" of his job as president/CEO of the Recording Academy and MusiCares is figuring out what to do about AI. item.title: More Beatles Biopic Cast Announced
item.description: The Beatles' cinematic universe is expanding.
